Our Services

About Us

Incorporation

Ensuring compliance with a host of local statutory company secretarial obligations is a time-consuming exercise, especially if you have companies registered in a number of different jurisdictions. We help our clients deal with registration, maintenance, administration and corporate governance matters concerning their corporate entities.

Our corporate secretarial team has in-depth experience in assisting our clients throughout the different stages of their companies’ lifecycles. We start by helping them establish and form various kinds of entities in different jurisdictions. Then, we ensure that these entities comply with corporate governance procedures and controls on a day-to-day basis, and that their statutory company secretarial obligations are properly executed and maintained on an ongoing basis.

Tax compliance & consulting

We have broad experience in both local and international tax issues. With the network of our associates, we are able to meet the changing needs of both local and global businesses operating in one of the world’s fastest growing and most dynamic regions. We are equipped to advise on tax matters relating to international operations, not only in Hong Kong but also on a regional and global basis.

Our services include:

  • Corporate and individual tax compliance services

  • Prepare of tax returns and computations

  • Tax investigation and field audit support

  • Review tax position of the accounts for offshore claims

  • Tax due diligence support on merger and acquisition transactions and structuring

Accounting and book-keeping

Accounting function not only provides useful information for management decision making, but also helps companies comply with the statutory accounting requirements. We offer a full range of accounting services to help you manage all your accounting issues.  Depending on your needs, we can provide monthly, quarterly or yearly bookkeeping accounting services for you.

Our bookkeeping and accounting service include :-

  • Organizing and filing the accounting documents provided by you

  • Recording the accounting transactions with computer applications by our professional staff

  • Preparing the income statement, balance sheet, general ledgers, trading debtor and trading creditor aging reports

  • Analyzing the inventory cycles

  • Inventory counting

Hong Kong, China and overseas trademark registrations

Our team, with our global associate network and affiliate offices, is familiar with the multinational issues and cultural concerns to which clients are facing. We are seriously involved in the intellectual property developments in Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, China and the United States.


Our services include:-

  • Trademark searching

  • Consultation on registration probability, strategy and availability of trademark

  • Proceedings advice on maintenance of registration of trademark

China business and tax consultation

We provide China accounting services and tax filing services few years ago. With our associate firm in Shenzhen, China, we act as a bridge to connect you and the authorities to solve any technical arguments with the authorities. To take advantage of our local and international expertise, our team provides expert knowledge on a vast range of country-specific accounting and tax issues in China.


 Our accounting and tax reporting services include:

  • Book-keeping

  • Accounting advisory

  • Financial reporting

  • Tax filing

  • Consolidation accounts

  • Training to finance staff

Our company: Services

HUMAN RESOURCES SOLUTIONS

We strive to provide SME in Hong Kong professional and cost effective human resources compliance and consulting services. Our services include :-


  • Preparation of monthly payroll report and respective employer’s return forms

  • Preparation of tailor-made employment agreement to suit the requirements of the parties

  • Calculation of the potential salaries tax liabilities

  • Employment contract and employee handbook review

  • Rental reimbursement scheme implementation and administration

  • Provision of the professional advice to ensure that the regulations are complied.
